summary.title: PBM Claim Event Bus Threat Model
summary.description: STRIDE threat model for the claim adjudication event bus, prepared during initial design review.

threats.title: Pharmacy credential theft via phishing
threats.description: Attacker phishes pharmacy staff credentials to submit fraudulent claims.
threats.mitigation: MFA required on pharmacy portal; rotating short-lived tokens

threats.title: Replay of submitted claim with altered NDC
threats.description: Attacker captures and replays a valid claim submission with the NDC code modified to trigger higher reimbursement.
threats.mitigation: Payload signing with HMAC over canonical JSON

threats.title: Token in CloudFront access logs
threats.description: Bearer token may appear in CloudFront access logs if not stripped at the edge.
threats.mitigation: CloudFront logging filters strip Authorization header

threats.title: High-volume duplicate submission DoS
threats.description: Attacker submits high volumes of duplicate claims to exhaust adjudication capacity.

threats.title: Pharmacy account elevated via missing tenant check
threats.description: Pharmacy account submits claims for a different tenant by omitting the tenant ID validation path.
threats.mitigation: Tenant ID validated on every claim against pharmacy-to-tenant mapping

threats.title: PHI in transit between adjudication and pricing services
threats.description: PHI is sent over Kafka to pricing-service for adjudication.
threats.mitigation: TLS 1.3 enforced on all Kafka topics including adjudication-to-pricing

threats.title: Service account compromise allows audit write impersonation
threats.description: A compromised service account could write fabricated audit entries or overwrite legitimate ones.
threats.mitigation: Service account isolation per writer process

threats.title: Audit entry modification after write
threats.description: Insider or compromised admin modifies written audit entries to cover tracks.
threats.mitigation: Write-once storage on DynamoDB with deny-update IAM policy

threats.title: Audit entries leak PHI in error fields
threats.description: Serialization errors may expose raw PHI field values in the audit entry error payload.

threats.title: Audit writer DOS via flood
threats.description: High-volume writes from a rogue service exhaust audit writer capacity and drop legitimate entries.

threats.title: Direct DynamoDB write bypasses audit serializer
threats.description: An actor with direct DynamoDB credentials bypasses the audit serializer to write arbitrary entries.
threats.mitigation: IAM policy restricts table writes to audit-writer role
